eligibility.reason: This E0 audit establishes only source integrity, file structure, metadata consistency and descriptive QC. It does not establish final untouched status, scientific validity, functional signal or model utility.

member_format.columns: gene followed by A-site footprint counts for successive CDS codons

qc_definitions.total_coverage: Sum of the unrounded per-codon counts within one transcript.
qc_definitions.zero_coverage_position: A CDS codon whose parsed count is exactly zero.
qc_definitions.long_tail_top_10pct_count_share: Sum of the largest ceil(CDS_codon_count * 0.10) counts divided by transcript total coverage; null when total coverage is zero.
qc_definitions.long_tail_max_count_share: Largest single-codon count divided by transcript total coverage; null when total coverage is zero.

outputs.clean_count_representation: original input token, without rounding or numeric normalization

limitations: Candidate-study E0 provenance and QC only; this is not a final untouched dataset designation.
The two lanes come from one Ribo experiment and are merged; they are not independent biological or technical replicates available for replication analysis.
RSEM 1.3.0 multi-mapping weights can produce non-integer counts; values are not unique-molecule counts and must not be rounded or silently converted to integers.
Only the frozen read-length/frame A-site offsets are supported; offsets for other read lengths or frames must not be inferred from this artifact.
Counts are already A-site-mapped CDS-codon summaries; this audit does not independently verify read alignment, P-site or A-site placement, gene annotation or sacCer3 coordinate correctness.
Duplicate genes must not be summed or collapsed, and duplicate SOFT metadata must be reported rather than silently deduplicated.
Descriptive coverage and long-tail statistics are not evidence of translation speed, functional effect, biological mechanism, generalization or model performance.
No functional conclusion, scientific positive claim, model training, calibration, selection or benchmark conclusion is authorized by this E0 artifact.
